text.en: 1. This Order is the Air Navigation (Protected Areas — Republic of Singapore Air Force Facilities) Order 2024 and comes into operation on 29 April 2024.

heading.en: Areas declared to be protected areas

text.en: 2. Any area described in the Schedule is declared to be a protected area for the purposes of sections 32 and 33 of the Act.
